description: Blender's Recalculate Normals Outside (mesh.normals_make_consistent). BFS over face adjacency (shared undirected edges): flip any neighbour that traverses a shared edge in the SAME direction as its already-oriented neighbour, making each connected component consistently wound; then per component compute signed volume and flip the whole component if negative so normals point outward. Unlike boolean_general::orient_outward (which only whole-mesh-flips an ALREADY-consistent mesh by volume sign), this repairs an inconsistently-wound polygon soup -- foundational for boolean, the CSG inside-test, and solidify. New MeshOp::RecalculateNormals. V&V: a cube with a subset of faces reversed recovers full consistency + positive signed volume; an all-inward cube flips outward; an already-correct cube is unchanged.
title: outram-blender: recalculate normals (make winding consistent + outward)

description: First cfMesh-port milestone in outram-park-fork-cfmesh. Establish the core index-based VolumeMesh (points + faces + owner/neighbour[Option] + n_cells + boundary patches, mirroring cfMesh polyMeshGen and outram-foam PolyMesh), and a structured Cartesian block mesher cartesian_box(min,max,[nx,ny,nz]) -> VolumeMesh (the axis-aligned hex grid the octree cartesianMesh builds on). Face normals oriented owner->neighbour (outward on boundary), internal faces first then per-patch boundary faces (6 patches). Pure Rust, Android-safe, zero deps (local minimal Vec3). V&V: box meshed nx*ny*nz -> correct cell count, internal-face count = (nx-1)ny nz + nx(ny-1)nz + nx ny(nz-1), 6 boundary patches with correct sizes, total_volume == box volume, per-cell face-area closure ~ 0 (validate).
title: cfmesh: core VolumeMesh + Cartesian block mesher (port milestone 1)
